basic_details.post_name: STLS, Staff Nurse, Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2022-23) and 5 more
basic_details.short_information: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Diamond Harbour Health District (DHHD), West Bengal, has invited applications for 18 posts in 8 roles under Advt No. DH&FWS/DHHD/1816/2026-27. The posts include STLS, Staff Nurse, Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2022-23), Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2023-24) and 4 more. The online application is open from 9 November 2026 to 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will DHHD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scoring of marks post-wise as per the Scale of Scoring (academic marks, experience) Computer Test (STLS, Block Data Manager, TB HV) Interview (Multi-Rehabilitation Worker - 5 marks) Verification of original documents STLS: total 50 marks - Class X 05, Class XII 10, Graduation with DMLT or BMLT 15, Experience 10, Computer Test 10 Staff Nurse: 100 marks based on % of marks in GNM/B.Sc Nursing Block Data Manager: total 100 - Class X 5, Class XII 10, Graduation 15, Computer Test 70 (qualifying 50%) Multi-Rehabilitation Worker: total 50 - Educational Qualification 35, Working experience 10, Interview 5 Community Health Assistant (Urban): 100 marks based on % of marks in ANM/GNM examination

content_sections.heading: DHHD Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No rounding off marks; proportionate marking up to 2 decimal points will be considered

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHHD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026. Applications opened on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHHD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies: 1 STLS, 2 Staff Nurse, 2 Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2022-23), 3 Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2023-24), 1 TB HV, 7 Multi-Rehabilitation Worker and 2 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHHD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved: Rs. 100. Reserved category: Rs. 50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - STLS: minimum 21 to Maximum 40 years; Staff Nurse: maximum 40 years; Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2022-23): 21 to 40 years; Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2023-24): 21 to 40 years; TB HV: minimum 21 to maximum 40 years. Relaxation: As per Govt. norm.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 25,000 (Monthly Consolidated) for STLS, 25,000 (Monthly Consolidated) for Staff Nurse, 22,000 (Monthly Consolidated) for Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2022-23), 22,000 (Monthly Consolidated) for Block Data Manager (XV-FC Health Grant 2023-24), 18,000 (Monthly Consolidated) for TB HV.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post-wise: Graduate with DMLT or BMLT (STLS); GNM or B.Sc Nursing with WBNC registration (Staff Nurse); Graduate with 1-year Computer Application diploma and experience (Block Data Manager); Science graduate with MPW/LHV/ANM/Health worker experience (TB HV); BPT with 2 years' hospital experience (Multi-Rehabilitation Worker); ANM or GNM with WBNC registration, female only (Community Health Assistant (Urban)). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. The applicant must have proficiency in Bengal (as printed). STLS: permanent two wheeler driving license and able to drive two wheeler. Community Health Assistant (Urban): only female candidates; permanent resident of Diamond Harbour Health District; proficient in Bengali.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Experience gained while pursuing the course will not be counted. Candidates found ineligible or absent at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages. No claim for SC, ST, OBC or Disability will be entertained after submission of the application.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scoring of marks post-wise as per the Scale of Scoring (academic marks, experience). Computer Test (STLS, Block Data Manager, TB HV). Interview (Multi-Rehabilitation Worker - 5 marks). Verification of original documents.
